description: Defines a SwiftUI struct `MenuHostedItem` that embeds a SwiftUI view within an AppKit `NSView`, enabling it to be used as a menu item in a macOS application. It manages sizing and updates for the embedded view within an `NSHostingView`.

classes.name: MenuHostedItem
classes.description: A SwiftUI wrapper that hosts arbitrary SwiftUI views as AppKit menu items via NSViewRepresentable for macOS integration.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and returns an `NSHostingView` embedding the SwiftUI `rootView` and applies sizing.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the rootView of the existing `NSHostingView` and reapplies sizing.

methods.name: applySizing
methods.description: Sets the width of the hosting view, calculates the fitting size, and adjusts the frame accordingly.
